purpose: CPU-only conservative source audit; no final evaluation selection or clinical equivalence claim
normalization: casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace, strip; SHA-256 of UTF-8

near_duplicate.method: Exact set Jaccard using global-frequency prefix candidate join and integer threshold checks; no approximate LSH

short_numeric_template.meaning: Conservative textual family only; numeric values may be clinically different; negation and all non-numeric text are preserved

components.group_id: minimum normalized-report SHA-256 in connected component
components.split_policy: A connected component must remain in one prospective split; old V1/V2/V3 splits and conclusions are immutable

diagnostic_fragments.parent_relation: Normalized full-fragment substring with Unicode word boundaries; all possible full-report parents recorded
diagnostic_fragments.meaning: Textual containment is a candidate source relation, not verified provenance or patient identity

limits: Near-duplicate and template groups do not establish medical equivalence or patient identity.
Template families, transitive closure and fragment containment may over-exclude reports.
Different wording, translations and unregistered historical sources may evade these textual rules.
Patient independence and foundation-model pretraining exposure remain unknown.
Availability counts are an input-only audit, not a new unseen final set or human review.
